baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَانِيَةً, ذُلِّلَتْ ... تَذْلِيلًا, and قُطُوفُهَا combine nearness, imposed pliancy, and harvestable clusters.
baseline_models.mechanism: The near cluster is not merely located within reach: the passive intensive verb and its cognate verbal noun foreground a thorough conversion of difficult reach into immediate harvestability.

activation_trace.role: Nearness and approximation supply the reduced distance that initiates the access mechanism.
Pliant ease after difficulty makes accessibility an effected change rather than a static location.
The low-hanging cluster gives the change a concrete harvest object and bodily scale.
Harvest time drawing near adds readiness in time to nearness in space.

changed_reading.before: Shade and fruit happen to be close to the inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: The garden actively abolishes both reaching friction and harvest delay for them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: دَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَالُهَا places an overhead cover near them, while ذُلِّلَتْ lowers the fruit-bearing layer.
baseline_models.mechanism: Canopy and clusters close vertical distance from above, producing an intimate architecture that both shelters and attends the body rather than a flat landscape viewed at a distance.

activation_trace.role: An overhead canopy supplies the upper layer that bends into the inhabitants' space.
Protective shelter and patronage turn overhead cover into attended security.
Nearness closes the gap between protective layer and protected person.
Low-hanging parts supply the downward edge of the enclosing architecture.

changed_reading.before: The ayah adds nearby botanical shade to the garden scene.
changed_reading.after: The garden stoops into a close protective architecture around the inhabitants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذُلِّلَتْ makes قُطُوفُهَا, not the human beneficiary, the grammatical bearer of imposed yielding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root keeps abasement as a live contrast, but the focus construction directs force toward the fruit's resistance and resolves it as gentle ease; the person remains picker and beneficiary rather than the humiliated object.

activation_trace.role: Abasement under overpowering preserves the coercive edge against which the focus allocation can be noticed.
Gentle yielding without humiliation supplies the benign outcome of the imposed change.
Pliant ease locates what is subdued in material difficulty rather than human dignity.
Picking or cutting remains the beneficiary's act after the object's resistance has yielded.

changed_reading.after: Subjection is selectively displaced from the person onto the obstacle to enjoyment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The thoroughly eased clusters join a spring that inhabitants make burst and route: paradise is a responsive medium whose produce and water alter their disposition around human use.

activation_trace.role: Pliant ease after difficulty supplies the focus-side transformation of resistant matter.
The accessible cluster gives responsive matter a harvestable focus object.
A flowing spring supplies material that can be routed rather than merely stored.
Wide splitting and outflow, intensified by verb and verbal noun, parallel the focus's thorough making-easy.

structural_cues: 76:6 pairs يُفَجِّرُونَهَا with تَفْجِيرًا; 76:14 pairs ذُلِّلَتْ with تَذْلِيلًا.
The inhabitants act on the spring in 76:6, while the fruit's adaptation is presented in the passive in 76:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two intensified material transformations; I infer a shared affordance system in which water and produce yield to use. A live alternative is that they are separate images of abundance with no common mechanics.

changed_reading.before: One kind of produce has been made easy to reach.
changed_reading.after: The garden's matter is dynamically responsive: both flow and reach are reconfigured around its inhabitants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who moved food toward a socially constrained captive without seeking return now receive food whose own vertical and material resistance has been removed; generosity across asymmetry returns as noncoercive accessibility.

activation_trace.role: Gentle yielding without humiliation supplies the noncoercive mode of the returned hospitality.
The accessible cluster is the food now brought within the former givers' reach.
Feeding another supplies the prior outward movement of food that the focus spatially reverses.
Binding and captivity mark the recipient's constraint, making the earlier feeding cross an asymmetry of power.

structural_cues: 76:8 joins feeding with the needy, orphan, and captive; 76:9 explicitly refuses repayment or thanks.
76:12 names compensation immediately before the focus garden description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies voluntary feeding of a bound recipient and later fruit made yielding; I infer a reciprocal inversion in which former givers receive without subordinating another person. A live alternative is a general reward correspondence without this social-spatial reversal.

changed_reading.before: Low fruit is a convenience granted to the rewarded inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: Its accessibility spatially reciprocates their earlier act of carrying food across vulnerability and constraint.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the scene explicitly excludes both sun and severe cold, the near shade need not solve a thermal problem; following divine protection from harm, it can function as the continued spatial presence of shelter and patronage.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary shade as covering supplies the thermal reading that context revises.
Protective shelter and patronage supply the nonthermal function retained after revision.
Nearness makes protection intimate and continuously present rather than remote.
Preventing harm establishes divine protection as an active function in the reward sequence.
The sun is explicitly negated, removing the usual cause that makes shade necessary.
Severe cold is also negated, completing the removal of climatic extremes.

structural_cues: The double negation of sun and severe cold in 76:13 immediately precedes the near shades of 76:14.
The reward sequence begins in 76:11 with protection from the day's harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior protection and an immediate negation of both thermal extremes; I infer that shade now embodies sheltering presence rather than heat relief. A live alternative is that shade remains a purely aesthetic garden feature.

changed_reading.before: The shades are nearby primarily to cool the inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: With no heat or cold to remedy, the close canopy materializes enduring protection and attended ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: Lowered canopy and fruit form the vertical component of a larger field: vessels and attendants circulate, measures fit, garments occupy the upper side, and sovereignty is experienced as the whole environment organizing around the beneficiary.

activation_trace.role: An upper part bending toward the middle supplies the body's compressed vertical field.
The overhead canopy establishes the field's upper boundary.
Low-hanging parts bring provision down to the beneficiary's bodily level.
The low cluster gives the vertical adjustment an immediately usable object.
Circulation around a center supplies the horizontal service orbit of vessels.
Matching a thing to its measure makes the service field calibrated rather than merely abundant.
A second circulation extends the orbit from vessels to attendants.
Sovereignty names the encompassing order that the yielding environment enacts.
The upper direction places garments above them and closes the field from the body outward.

structural_cues: عَلَيْهِم recurs in 76:14, 76:15, and 76:19, followed by عَالِيَهُمْ in 76:21.
The sequence combines downward nearness, repeated circling, exact measure, and an explicitly great kingdom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies converging vertical, circular, and measured relations; I infer a beneficiary-centered geometry in which sovereignty appears as environmental coordination. A live alternative is a catalog of independent amenities with no unified spatial system.

changed_reading.before: A single bough has been lowered near a reclining person.
changed_reading.after: The bough is one component of a calibrated kingdom whose heights, paths, vessels, and attendants center on the inhabitants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition on obeying a sinner keeps moral agency from yielding, while the focus makes fruit yield instead; a context branch that joins compliance to prepared pasture and fruit makes this allocation materially exact.

activation_trace.role: Abasement under force supplies the danger from which the human subject is kept.
Pliant ease assigns yielding to the material obstacle instead.
The fruit cluster identifies the compliant object that serves without compromising human agency.
Obedience and compliance supply the social relation explicitly refused to the human addressee.
Pasture or fruit becoming ready materially joins the obedience root to the focus's prepared cluster.

structural_cues: 76:24 uses the negative imperative لَا تُطِعْ with the person as agent; 76:14 uses passive ذُلِّلَتْ with clusters as subject.
The two constructions distribute compliance to different grammatical participants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prohibition on human obedience and a branch where compliance describes ready fruit; I infer a deliberate redistribution of yielding from moral agent to provision. A live alternative is that the ethical command and physical accessibility are unrelated.

changed_reading.before: The fruit is subdued for convenience.
changed_reading.after: Provision is made compliant precisely where the person's ethical agency must remain unbowed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reward follows patience, while lovers of the immediate abandon a heavy future day; the focus's nearness and arrived harvest therefore figure a future good made present at maturity, not a good seized prematurely.

activation_trace.role: The nearer or first side makes morally ambiguous immediacy a live focus possibility.
Harvest time arriving supplies mature readiness rather than premature acquisition.
Restraint from panic supplies the waiting by which the garden reward is reached.
Hurrying and advancing supply the condemned rival form of nearness.
Heaviness marks the deferred day that the impatient leave behind.

structural_cues: 76:12 attributes the garden reward to patience before 76:14 describes nearness.
76:27 opposes love of ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ to leaving a heavy day behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, condemned immediacy, a heavy future, and an arrived harvest; I infer that the focus redeems nearness as ripened futurity. A live alternative is that دَانِيَةً is only spatial and carries no temporal contrast.

changed_reading.before: Nearness means only that shade and fruit occupy little physical distance.
changed_reading.after: Patiently awaited reward has ripened into nearness, sharply unlike attachment to the premature immediate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus does not erase agency: the beneficiary still picks, but the path and conditions of taking have been made easy. The closing sequence's willing, taking a path, and dependence on divine willing clarifies this split between uptake and enablement.

activation_trace.role: Picking or cutting supplies the beneficiary's retained act of uptake.
Pliant ease supplies the prior enabling condition that removes resistance to uptake.
Will directed toward a thing supplies the human initiative in taking a path.
The repeated willing relation nests human initiative within divine willing and supplies the enabling side.
An extended traversable path gives agency an already opened medium.
Taking and handling supply the active acquisition that remains after access is enabled.

structural_cues: 76:29 sequences willing, taking, and a path; 76:30 then qualifies willing by divine willing.
76:14 uses a passive causative for accessibility while قُطُوف retains the action-image of picking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human willing and taking inside a divinely conditioned path; I infer the same division in the focus between active picking and passively supplied accessibility. A live alternative is that the closing agency statement has no local bearing on harvest mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Effort is simply removed because fruit comes to the recipient.
changed_reading.after: The recipient retains meaningful uptake, while the possibility, path, and ease of reaching are supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing act of entering persons into mercy gives the focus canopy a topological force: protective shade is not only over them but a local image of mercy becoming an inhabitable enclosure.

activation_trace.role: An overhead canopy supplies the bounded spatial form into which the inhabitants are gathered.
Protective patronage supplies the canopy's merciful function.
Nearness makes the enclosing protection experientially immediate.
Entry into an interior supplies the spatial arrow from recipient to enclosing state.
Mercy and tenderness identify the enclosing state that the protective shade can locally render.

structural_cues: 76:31 uses the spatial verb يُدْخِلُ with mercy as the destination.
76:14 places the garden's shades over the inhabitants rather than merely before their sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry into mercy and a near protective canopy; I infer that the canopy renders mercy as inhabitable space. A live alternative is that mercy is a broad closing category unrelated to the focus's geometry.

changed_reading.before: The canopy is an external cover above the inhabitants.
changed_reading.after: The canopy becomes a local spatial image of their being enclosed within mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the napped-cloth branch is form-distant from قُطُوف as fruit clusters; it remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by silk and garments elsewhere in the packet, but downstream prose should present only a tactile analogy and must not replace fruit with cloth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُطُوفُهَا (ق ط ف) stands beside the overhead ظِلَالُهَا, allowing the packet's napped-cloth branch to color how the clustered canopy feels.

activation_trace.role: Napped cloth supplies a soft textured surface as a deliberately contained analogy for the clusters.
The overhead canopy lets the tactile cluster image behave like a draped covering.
Fine silk supplies an explicit soft textile immediately before the orchard scene.
Clothing supplies a later bodily covering that echoes the canopy's draped relation.

changed_reading.before: Fruit and shade form a botanical overhead layer.
changed_reading.after: As a contained tactile analogy, clusters and shade form a soft, textile-like layer draped around the body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it connects orchard provision to revelation across domains; it remains anchored in focus nearness, low hanging, and an intensified verb-noun construction echoed by 76:23, but downstream prose should call it a formal-spatial resonance, not claim that the fruit semantically denotes revelation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دَانِيَةً and ذُلِّلَتْ ... تَذْلِيلًا present a gift brought downward and thoroughly into reach.

activation_trace.role: Nearness supplies the endpoint of downward accommodation.
Low-hanging parts supply the focus's downward material form.
Caused descent and delivery, also intensified by verb and verbal noun, supply the cross-domain formal analogue.
Reading and recitation identify the descending item as communicated word, containing the analogy to delivery rather than botany.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is physically lowered into reach.
changed_reading.after: As a formal resonance, material provision joins a wider gift-logic in which what benefits humans is delivered down into accessible form.

strongest_changes: The negation of both sun and severe cold revises shade from thermal relief into near protective patronage.
Repeated circulation, exact measure, and upper-lower cues turn one low branch into a body-centered service geometry and enacted kingdom.
Feeding the captive and refusing return recast accessible fruit as a noncoercive reciprocity across prior vulnerability.
The prohibition on human obedience activates a selective transfer: provision yields so the moral agent need not.
Patience versus love of the immediate gives nearness temporal force as mature future reward brought within reach.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the same focus mechanics without detaching from its words: water becomes routable, food reverses social direction, climate ceases to explain shade, services orbit the body, compliance moves from person to provision, and closing agency and mercy statements clarify who takes, who enables, and what encloses.
remaining_uncertainties: Protective patronage is strongly activated by the absence of thermal need, but shade may still be primarily aesthetic covering.
The transfer of subjection from person to provision is grammatically visible yet may remain an abductive ethical overlay rather than a deliberate lexical contrast.
The textile and revelation analogies are branch-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory even though their focus anchors and contextual echoes resolve cleanly.
